name: voc-hub-responder
description: Triage VoC Hub records from a local stack over the X-API-Key integration API: list open VoCs, save a draft, move a status, and send a customer or internal reply. Gates every send on a human approving the mode, recipient, and subject — because `compose` picks the recipient, approving a customer reply is not approving an internal mail. Also exports every VoC visible to a read key into one JSON file via cursor pagination (voc-hub-exporter skill), with incremental re-export from the previous sync_watermark.
